generated.description: A long, sleek high-speed train built from gray and light gray terracotta, quartz blocks and slabs, and black stained glass windows, with iron block accents and a row of beacons along the roof. It is about 172 blocks long, 7 high and 7 deep, with roughly 3,500 blocks in total. Its interior has chests, hoppers, signs and flower pots, and the build is shown as a modern, futuristic train.
